P0 observation/action contract preservation must be machine-checkable
diagnostics and hidden values must be separated from actor-visible extraction
supersedes: direct high-fidelity backend implementation without a checked contract
direct high-fidelity rollout before current-sim parity preflight
manual inspection of actor observation/action contract preservation

public_gates: M2473 must implement a local HF0 contract module and focused tests
M2473 must generate a summary artifact proving canonical P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3 under current-sim parity preflight
M2473 must prove hidden diagnostics and oracle labels are not read by the P0 observation extractor
M2473 must preserve actor_input_contract_changed false and action_contract_changed false

M2473 must not train rank controllers select winners or make paper self-ID finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim or high-fidelity validation claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run external high-fidelity simulation
do not execute policy rollout beyond local shape preflight
do not change the deployed action contract
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim high-fidelity validation readiness
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the HF0 design into checked local interface code and current-sim parity preflight artifacts without external simulation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: HF0 contract implementation/preflight only; no external simulation, measured validation, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, or validation verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if canonical current-sim P0 observation is not 72 values
stop if action shape is not 3
stop if hidden diagnostics are read by the P0 extractor
stop if implementation requires external high-fidelity dependencies
stop if actor or action contract flags are not false
fallback_plan: repair the contract module if shape checks fail
repair extractor boundaries if diagnostics leak into actor view
route to current-sim adapter smoke only after local contract checks pass
stop for user review if preserving P0 contract requires a design change
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2472 selected contract implementation/preflight as the bounded next route

admission_evidence: M2472 specifies DynamicsBackend boundary and P0 observation extractor requirements
docs/observation-contract.md defines canonical P0 72-value frame and three-dimensional action contract
current-sim AutoDriftEnv provides reset step action and observation contracts for parity checks
allowed_updates: M2473 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the implementation
next_stage_criteria: summary artifact records P0 observation shape 72 action shape 3 and no diagnostics leak
bounded current-sim adapter smoke or external-backend design route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2473 implements interface preflight and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2473; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2472 HF0 design and current observation contract.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight fails, classify it as interface contract readiness failure rather than driver or self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: creates checked interface infrastructure for the high-fidelity branch instead of another current-sim static artifact
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare validation infrastructure but cannot itself establish paper or high-fidelity evidence
must_synthesize_if: HF0 contract cannot preserve P0 observation/action shape
three further high-fidelity interface milestones remain non-executable without parity smoke evidence

hypothesis: A local HF0 contract implementation and current-sim parity preflight can make high-fidelity interface boundaries machine-checkable without external simulation or actor/action contract changes.
success_criteria: tests/test_high_fidelity_interface.py exists and focused tests pass
summary reports actor_input_contract_changed false action_contract_changed false hidden_values_enter_actor_input false oracle_labels_enter_actor_input false
no external high-fidelity simulation training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2473 requires Chrono or another external high-fidelity simulator to run local tests
M2473 changes actor input or action contract
M2473 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2473 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2473 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result

commands.name: focused_tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_high_fidelity_interface.py

decision_rule: M2473 passes if it implements checked HF0 contract/preflight artifacts preserving P0 observation/action contracts without external high-fidelity simulation, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
